newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end firmer, Bund spreads steady.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end firmer, Bund spreads steady.

text.p: Portuguese bonds ended firmer with yield spreads against Bunds consolidating around 65 basis points. Dealers said shorter bonds could correct tomorrow and that the yield curve could flatten.
"Futures and cash traded in a narrow range and 10-year Bonds held a steady spread against Bunds of around 65 bp," a dealer said.
Another said: "The long bond is well-supported and it is unlikely that the yield spread against Bunds will widen tomorrow."
